lead_raw_text:
The structure of ZnAgSe₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Immm (No. 143), with a cell formula of Zn₂Ag₂Se₄ containing 8 atoms across 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Ag and Zn each adopt tetrahedral environments with four Se neighbors, while Se centers coordinate to two Ag and two Zn neighbors. The resulting geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 8 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-sharing between Ag- and Zn-centered tetrahedra and corner- and edge-sharing among like Ag and like Zn tetrahedra.
